title: Enterprise on-ramp map and quick-scope for aggregated sales asks
creator: Maya Patel
description: Sales and Customer Success have been routing a high volume of non-bug enterprise feature asks as individual tickets. This work aims to create a repeatable 'on-ramp' mapping and lightweight scoping workflow that: 1) aggregates related asks from high-touch accounts, 2) produces a one-page impact & risk snapshot per bundle, and 3) outputs starter implementation tickets with 1-2 sprint 'T-shirt' estimates for Engineering. Goal is faster first-response to customers and better prioritization signals for PM/Eng.
acceptance_criteria: Run 2 pilot bundles from queued Sales/CS asks and produce one-page scope snapshots
Generate engineering starter tickets for each bundle with an estimate and area owner
Obtain alignment from at least 2 account execs and a solutions engineer on the pilot outputs
Document the aggregator process and handoff checklist in Confluence and a one-click intake template for CS
deliverables: Aggregator spreadsheet with cluster keys and scoring (value/effort/strategic-fit)
One-page scope snapshot template (problem, proposed solution, assumptions, econ, risk)
Starter Linear tickets for eng with linked artifacts and suggested owners
Confluence 'on-ramp' playbook and CS intake checklist
